reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Loy, Christian & Kevin.
They put in new under cabinet lighting in our kitchen, repaired and replaced bulbs in the lights above the cabinets too & installed to replacement fixtures upstairs. I called for the appointment yesterday, they came today & promptly finished the job. Everything looks great! Just in time for holiday hosting. Thank you Milestone!

Michael O'Connor was kind, friendly, personable, compassionate and caring.  He exemplified customer service and showed true concern for our issues as if they were his immediate responsibility.  He is a person of good character and integrity.

Nathan was our master electrician.  He is competent, compassionate and committed to excellence. He handled our home with great respect.  He has a dedicated spirit and will take ownership of issues.  He is passionate about his work and genuinely believes in

I'm writing this review out of significant disappointment with Milestone and the AC unit they installed. My AC unit, installed by Milestone in 2017, recently experienced an evaporator coil failure and is leaking refrigerant. This is incredibly frustrating, as the unit is less than 10 years old.

Even more concerning is the warranty issue. Despite what I understood to be a 10-year warranty, both the manufacturer and Milestone are refusing to honor it, claiming the warranty was only 5 years becaus

First time using Milestine Electric, A/C,
Plumbing Dec 2025. A technician, Mr.Garza was very profesdional, polite, friend, and took his time explain his inspection of our 26 year old system. He gave options on some things that needed to be address.
He also gave the pros and cons of each option so we could make a good decision on what we needed to do.

I'm one of those customers who asks many questions, and have high expectations on services and products that is purchased.
From the first call to

I had what seemed to be a small problem. After I agreed to the quote, the job turned out to be much more difficult. Specifically my kitchen 3 pole lighting system has to be redone from scratch. Clint and his assistant were very professional and completed the job at the quoted price despite it being 105 degrees outside. Great work. They installed additional accessories panels for a junction box that had been walked in and was hidden, rewired 4 light switches to allow two sets of two to work indep

JB and Stephen were fantastic at today’s appointment!

Over the weekend, we started noticing our lights flickering around the house, which caused our battery backup system to kick in a few times. By Saturday evening, it happened about five times, and each time the battery took over saying the grid was out. We called Oncor, and they confirmed that one of the lugs in our meter box was going bad - and even worse, the wires were starting to melt together.

Since Milestone had already done great work

On 11/17 Jacob Kellar and Eduardo Cardona both came to my home to assess my electric needs. Both were very polite and professional. They seemed very knowledgeable and passionate about their job. They were able to address all my questions or concerns.
On 11/18 Tyler Spears, Jeff Meier and another young man (didn't get his name) came out the next day and performed all the electrical work needed to upgrade my panel. They worked hard 9am until after 5pm to until the job was done. They tested all the

We had a $30,000 AC installed a year ago. It is now leaking condensation for the second time. While we really like that they are very nice on the phone, the soonest they could get a tech out is in 6 days.  I should also note that we bought their Advantage Service plan.  Because we are going to be travelling when they had a first available appointment,  we will now be dealing with this second leak for three weeks.

We really do like Milestone and have used them several times for other repairs but

Tyler with Milestone Electric, AC, & Plumbing came out today to replace a rusted AC pan, unclog the drains, and service our unit. He did a fantastic job and explained everything thoroughly. He even took a video to show us the before and after aspects of the repair. Tyler removed all the old parts and took them with him, so I didn't have to dispose of anything. He left all areas he worked in clean and tidy. He was professional and courteous. He even wore plastic covers over his shoes when indoors

Service is amazing. Team is kind, knowledgable and responsive. So why a 2 star review? Because i just paid a bill and there is a flat 25 fuel surcharge. I am a milestone member and I too consume gas to get to work. I don't pass that down to my family. Fuel fluctuations are part of the cost of doing business. Do customers get a credit when prices drop?

New customer. Called them to schedule a same day service. The receptionist told me it was $29 service fee. They came in and checked and figured out it is gas-heated and we don't have gas on. NO REPAIR. CHARGED US $149 extra, $179 in total. In a place where you could just tell us oh you forget to turn on your gas and we will really appreciate the service and be a loyal customer, you instead charged us $149 for a lesson. You call that a fair price? Will never use your service again. Thank you Mile

Used Milestone for an electrical issue. The tech was promote and knowledgeable. Scheduling was easy.  They had a great online coupon which they honored - so saved my some $$. I highly recommend their services.

Robert Keyser is outstanding! He took the time to explain everything thoroughly and was completely honest and upfront throughout the process. I never felt pressured or hustled—just genuinely cared for. Milestone’s slogan “Fix in a Flash” is spot on, but they should also highlight their exceptional customer service. And that Advantage Program? Absolutely amazing!

Will Memzies performed a unit check up and did an exceptional job. This was not the first time that he has serviced my home. I appreciate his customer service as well as overall profesional yet laid back demeanor.

Julio with Milestone did a great job of repairing our issue. He did an extensive examination of all the electrical things in our house. He recommended three options to get our older house up to date.  He had a couple of options for payment. Made everything super easy. Looking forward to feeling safer with the new items Julio and his crew installs. Peace of mind is a good thing.  Thanks, Julio!!
Milestone was great about honoring their warranty! An new LED ceiling light installed in July went out. They sent Darcy the next day and he replaced it. Great service!

I contacted Milestone for a plumbing issue, and Wayne arrived on time. He repaired the toilet and even took the extra step to check the other bathroom and the hot water heater. Milestones customer service truly stands out. Their technicians are knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. I highly recommend.

The Good:
Tre Stiefer was absolutely outstanding. He took the time to clearly explain everything to me in a way that was easy to understand. His knowledge and experience really stood out, and he managed to expedite the work without ever rushing through the details. I especially appreciated the practical advice he gave me on how to keep my HVAC system running efficiently and extend its lifespan. Truly top-notch service—I couldn’t recommend him more highly!

The bad: Milestone appears to have a ve

I had the pleasure of working with Ricardo from Milestone Electric, and I couldn't be happier with the service! He came to our home to resolve an issue with the lighting in our master bedroom. Not only did he expertly diagnose and fix the problem, but he went above and beyond by kindly picking up our groceries while we were outside. He arranged them neatly on our kitchen counter, which was such a thoughtful gesture.

Additionally, Ricardo performed a thorough electrical safety evaluation, provid

Last year we had an electrical issue and we had service on our AC. This year we needed our AC/heat check.  We have been extremely pleased with Milestone.  Today, our HVAC tech was Kyle B.  Excellent service clear & documented needs and fair pricing with finance options.  Loved the video documentation.
Willy did an amazing job hanging our new chandelier. Excellent service. He did a free safety home inspection too.

Another great example of service from Milestone! Technician was happy, loves his job, professional and went the extra mile to ensure everything was working properly. Cannot say enough good things about this company. They do things right!

I had an outstanding experience with Terrance, our HVAC maintenance technician. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, courteous, and incredibly thorough. He went above and beyond to ensure our system was running at peak performance.

Terrance took the time to explain everything he was doing, identified potential issues before they became problems, and even went the extra mile to clean and fine-tune areas that others might have overlooked. His attention to detail, technical expertise,

Milestone came out to do some work in the bathrooms. The entire crew from Milestone were all great. Super friendly. Took the the time to walk through the issue along with various solutions. Answered all my questions. Can’t say enough. Milestone has a great team.

Bryan was so great when he came to our home. He wasn’t pushing the services and let us make our own decisions. He left a very good impression on me and my wife. He was very knowledgeable and complimented on how nice our home was. We requested him to come back and do the work himself.

Zaul sought out and found the problem with the lack of air conditioning in the upstairs that happened right after the previous technician had done a maintenance evaluation of both HVAC units on Friday the 19th. He found the heat exchanger unit for the upstairs hvac was leaking refrigerant.  He fixed the valves and added refrigerant. The upstairs is getting cool again.
I wish the problem hadn’t happened, but I’m glad Zaul came and fixed it.

Review #2 for Matt…
It was good that Matt came by to ev

Clayton Berryhill just came by my house in the evening after I put in a call about a potential warranty for my system Milestone installed. He was very thorough with the process and ultimately the root cause of the issue which was just a clogged line. Fixed the issue quickly and gave great tips of what to watch for in the future. Great customer service as always from Milestone.

I have been using Milestone since 2017. I have never been disappointed with their service or their performance. Our last technician, Travon, was a delightful young man who was very knowledgeable, professional, and skilled at his job. He made sure to answer all questions and to make sure I was satisfied before he left.

Milestone’s semi annual maintenance check has kept our heat and air working well.  They are easy to communicate with and schedule.  We’ve had them for more than 10 years and are very happy with their service and the people they employ.  They are always knowledgeable and polite.

Milestone's monthly advantage plan is a great option to assist with regular home maintenance. Not only do they offer members free benefits that you might not think to do, but the HVAC tune up (AC and heating system checks) are worth the price alone.

For less than $25 a month, only a fool doesn't have this service. And the service team and partner servicers are top quality and offer excellent customerservice!

Our heater was not working on the first coldest night of the year. I called Milestone after trying AirCo in the past and wasn't impressed with the work and service from the latter. Milestone did their best to accommodate my availability and sent Christian Kercher to inspect my heater issue. He was able to diagnose that my thermostat needed reprogramming and that my initial air handler wires had been originally improperly installed. We mentioned that we were moving and selling our house soon, and

Cody Roberts arrived on time, worked efficiently,
ran several tests and strategically diagnosed the deficiency within my unit. He gave me an honest accessment, made some suggestions and culminated with options and solutions.
A written estimate was reviewed.
EXCELLENT!

Very pleased with all aspects of the work completed by Milestone.  Replaced outside A/C unit, cleared a drain, and fixed a ceiling fan that was not working.
The work required technicians from 3 departments. all of whom were outstanding. They kept me informed and were willing to answer any questions I had.   All appointments were completed on time and went as planned.

Devon Bramhall did an outstanding job! I had him come out to check on a fan that wasn’t working. He immediately diagnosed the issue and saved me a weekend of frustration trying to troubleshoot it myself. Instead of aimlessly chasing down the problem, Devon quickly determined that the fan was bad and explained everything clearly. Having a professional like him come out not only minimized my downtime but also gave me peace of mind. Highly recommend Devon and Milestone for anyone needing fast, reli

Zach is amazing. He sensed how I just wanted a no frills information and he delivered.  I didn't need to know the "WHY" as much as I needed to know "WHAT" was required. Very kind and polite, explaining thing thoroughly with appropriate options.  His patience in re-explaining is honorable to me.

I'd recommend Mr. Zach Williams to anyone who needed a true honest opinion. He is great.

We loved our experience with Austin. He was extremely knowledgeable and great at explaining to us what was going on with our unit. We overall had a great experience with him and excited to work with him in the future!

We also had Landon and Zach come out and they were also extremely knowledgeable and kind. Would definitely recommend the whole company. We have had nothing but respect and kindness from everyone!

Clean, professional and on time. Will made sure I knew about the complimentary electrical safety check. Even tho it was free, he did a thorough evaluation, inspection and reported the findings and walked me through the documentation. I’m a forever customer!

Armando was our technician. He was very personable and professional. Throughout the service he provided excellent communication. He explained what he planned to do thoroughly. He seemed to be very knowledgeable, clean and respectful of our property. He wore booties to keep from bringing dirt or debris into our house. He was very organized and had proper tools to do his work. I would ask for him again without hesitation. Thank you.

Electrician Josh was awesome! He couldn’t duplicate the gripe (he didn’t find anything not working) so instead of hiding it & suckering me into spending a ton of money, he instead was honest. It wasn’t like he even thought about it; he just showed me everything was okay. He did present me a quote if I wanted to upgrade, and he spoke about the membership so he did good. I called Milestone secondly because the first company couldn’t come out the same day. That just changed as I’m calling Milestone

Roberto was great! Very knowledgeable and helpful! He explained everything very thoroughly to me and was very patient! He made sure to really clean the plumbing pipe and was thorough with the job as well. 10/10 recommend.

Devor delivered outstanding service and demonstrated exceptional professionalism throughout the entire process. He is extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and detail-oriented in his work. He took the time to clearly explain what needed to be done, ensured all of my questions were addressed, and provided a level of care that went above and beyond expectations. His expertise and dedication made the experience seamless and stress-free. I would highly recommend Devor at Milestone Electric A/C & Plumbi

Francisco L came out to my house for furnace check. He did a very thorough job and was excellent at explaining  everything to me.  He gave me all my options for repairs and help me decide which was most important. Highly recommend Milestone and Francisco.

Matthew did a great job figuring out why power was lost in two rooms but breaker did not trip. Found loose wires and repaired plus checked other outlets and found similar wiring not done well. We added items to his workload and he took care of them with a great attitude. He installed a new ceiling fan, 2 outdoor lights, and a new outlet in our garage in addition to the original problem. We are very pleased!

Roberto from Milestone Plumbing Service provided exceptional service! He thoroughly explained the purpose of the P-trap in the shower, clarifying why water remains in the pipe. He also proactively advised preparing for potential hot water heater failure due to its age, demonstrating his expertise and care. His service was beyond outstanding, and I will definitely contact Milestone for future plumbing needs. Highly recommend Roberto!

We are proud Milestone Club members and always appreciate the professional services we receive from their representatives. Most recently we had Ryan Allan out to tune up the furnaces for the cold weather to come. He has been to our house previously and is always congenial, professional and communicates very well. Thank You, Milestone.

They’re awesome!! Dustin Beal was especially great as he took us through the digital walk through of ducts and other things in the attic that we would otherwise never get to see. He explained to us why certain rooms weren’t cooling as effectively and efficiently as the others…that makes us take a more informed decision which we appreciate a lot. Thanks, Dustin, and your amazing call center support team and Milestone. 🙏🏽😊
Steven and Jacob were the best. They really did great work were so nice respectable and friendly really great guys. Very hard-working didn’t stop till the project was over.

Robert Galvan - the technician Milestone sent to me today was absolutely one of the very best techs I've ever had the pleasure to work with!! Milestone is extremely lucky to have come across him!! Thank you again Milestone for "turning my lemon into lemonade!!" God bless.

Tom Prejean

This was the first time we used Milestone for a plumbing issue. We ended up having 2 toilets replaced. Both technicians who came to the house were very knowledgeable and courteous. Francisco who installed the toilets cleaned up the area very nicely.

The semi-annual heating/air equipment check and tune-up under the Milestone Advantage program is worth every penny! Such great peace of mind. Even with suggested non-critical work from the tech the sales pressure is never felt. The techs do a great job of informing and answering questions but are comfortable leaving the final call in the customer’s hands with that unneeded pressure.
